docs.title: Lait-Crème Fluid+ Eco-Refill
docs.subtitle:
Introducing Eco-Refill For Your Lait-Crème Fluid+

A Sustainable Choice for Nourished Skin

Make a conscious choice for the environment and your skin with our eco-refill option for Lait-Crème Fluid+, the versatile moisturizer that delivers exceptional benefits. By choosing the eco-refill, you're reducing waste and continuing to enjoy the same nourishing and protective care for your skin.

The Lait-Crème Fluid+ is the lightweight, all-in-one solution inspired by our cult-favorite Lait-Crème Concentré. This innovative formula offers the same deep hydration and nourishment but with a lighter texture that's perfect for the whole family.

Triple-Action Formula for Radiant Skin

Lait-Crème Fluid+ is formulated with 98% ingredients of natural origin, including Aloe Vera Bio, Beeswax, and Shea Butter. This unique combination works in synergy to:

1. Hydrates and Nourishes: Like Lait-Crème Concentré, it nourishes and hydrates the skin for long-lasting comfort.

2. Enrich and Protect: It replenishes essential nutrients to keep skin healthy and supple, creating a protective barrier against environmental aggressors.

3. Lightweight and Versatile: The unique texture absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, making it ideal for all skin types.

Lait-Crème Fluid+ goes beyond just moisturizing; it's a versatile skincare essential that adapts to your needs:

Face and Body Moisturizer: This moisturizer delivers instant and long-lasting hydration for a radiant complexion and hydrates without leaving a greasy residue, leaving skin feeling soft and smooth.

Makeup Base: Create a smooth, hydrated canvas for flawless makeup application.

Cleanser and Makeup Remover: Gently remove makeup and impurities without stripping your skin's natural moisture barrier.

After-Sun Soother: Calm and cool sun-exposed skin with a soothing dose of hydration.

Aftershave Relief: Men can benefit too! Calm razor burn and reduce redness, leaving skin feeling refreshed.

Suitable for All Skin Types

Lait-Crème Fluid+ is dermatologist-tested and suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. It's a gentle yet effective skincare solution for the whole family, safe for children as young as 3 years old.

Lightweight, Non-Greasy Texture

The lightweight, non-greasy texture of Lait-Crème Fluid+ absorbs quickly, leaving no sticky residue. It's ideal for those who prefer a multi-functional and effective daily moisturizer.

Year-round hydration for All Climates

With its unique milky texture, Lait-Crème Fluid+ addresses the essential skincare needs of all individuals, regardless of skin type or climate. It's particularly well-suited for use in warm and humid environments.

Embrace Eco-Refills and Experience the Benefits of Lait-Crème Fluid+

Switch to eco-refills and continue enjoying the nourishing benefits of Lait-Crème Fluid+ while reducing your environmental impact. With its versatile formula and lightweight texture, this skincare essential is a must-have for your beauty routine.

docs.title: 3-in-1 Secret Paste
docs.subtitle:
1 Secret Paste, 3 possibilities:

1. S.O.S. ANTI-BLEMISH CARE

Do you have a new pimple? Applied directly to blemishes in the evening, 3 in 1 Secret Paste works overnight to dry out pimples and reduce redness.

2. ANTI-SHINE MASK

When applied in a thick layer once or twice a week for 10 minutes, 3-in-1 Secret Paste works as an absorbent, purifying mask that directly targets sebum production. Rinsed off with water, detoxified skin immediately looks fresher and healthier, and imperfections are visibly diminished.

3. DAILY PURIFYING CLEANSER

Once a day, massage the 3 in 1 Secret Paste over damp skin, like a classic cleanser and enjoy the extra purifying

and deep cleansing benefits. It leaves skin perfectly clean and ready for the subsequently applied active ingredients.
